manga.description: Three meals today, posterity tomorrow, all in reverie.

manga.title: Prelude Suite: Blood Diamond
manga.description: Behind the curtain, beyond the applause, the crimson stage of death is now in full readiness.

manga.title: OPERATIONS PREPARATION DETACHMENT A1
manga.description: Fang, Beagle, and Kroos, trainee police officers of Columbia's Operations Preparation Detachment, are posted to intern in a pocket of the trade port Tkaronto. They have no idea a Catastrophe is already slipping silently toward Tkaronto...

manga.title: Sui's Daily Slices: Wanna Shoot a Picture?
manga.description: Perhaps, this is a surer thing than memory could hope to be.

manga.title: Prelude Suite: Old Wounds
manga.description: Rebel fangs defy order, price paid with raging fire.

manga.title: Cecelia and the Sauin Pilgrimage
manga.description: May the fireworks of home light your way back.

manga.title: Prelude Suite: Keen-Edge, Silver Blade
manga.description: The silver edge is unsheathed and Karlan takes its first steps.

manga.title: Angelina - Sketches of this Messenger's Journey
manga.description: An Angelina sets out on a journey across Terra to perform a special task for Rhodes Island: collecting data from every field operator's monitoring bracelet.

manga.title: Prelude Suite: Cadenza Virtuosa
manga.description: These strings shall sound the notes of a soul.

manga.title: Rhodes Island's Records of Originium - Blacksteel
manga.description: A story between Franka, Liskarm, Vanilla, and Jessica from Blacksteel WorldWide before they were Rhodes Island Operators.

manga.title: Rhodes Island's Records Of Originium - Rhine Lab
manga.description: Ifrit discovers an uninvited guest aboard Rhodes Island, a girl named Darya. Darya's small form casts a long shadow over Ifrit, Silence, and Saria as she conjures in them memories of a buried past.

manga.title: Rhodes Kitchen - Tidbits
manga.description: This is a collection of files regarding the daily lives of Rhodes Island's operators as they relate to food. May the smells of the kitchen warm our hearts and guide us true on the road ahead. The past is gone, it's good for now.

manga.title: Prelude Suite: The Lone Walker
manga.description: To the guardian in age-long loneliness.
